name: check_room
description: Checks whether a room can be booked for one requested time slot today and answers Available or Unavailable. Every time is a whole number of minutes since midnight, from 0 to 1440: hours * 60 + minutes, so 09:00 = 540, 10:00 = 600, 13:45 = 825, 24:00 = 1440. Never pass a time as a string like "11:00". All five arguments are required; if the user did not give one of them, ask instead of guessing. This tool only checks: it does not save, create, change or cancel any booking.

start.description: Requested start of the slot, in whole minutes since midnight (10:00 = 600).

end.description: Requested end of the slot, in whole minutes since midnight (11:00 = 660, 24:00 = 1440).

now.description: The current time of day, in whole minutes since midnight (09:00 = 540).

blocked.description: true if the room is blocked (for example for maintenance), false if it is not.

bookings.description: Bookings the room already has today, each as {"start": minutes, "end": minutes}. Use [] when there are none.

start.description: Start of an existing booking, in minutes since midnight.

end.description: End of an existing booking, in minutes since midnight.
